Deliver low-latency, high-availability connectivity for trading, analytics, and enterprise systems. Operations & Resilience Deploy AIOps for predictive fault detection and closed-loop remediation, working closely with ITCC and SRE teams. Design systems where telemetry data from production automatically triggers improvements in the engineering blueprints and deployment pipelines (e.g., automatic capacity scaling, security patch deployment). Risk & Compliance Integrate security engineering into delivery pipelines; maintain zero regulatory findings and aim for zero audit points. Ensure full compliance with MAS TRM, NIST CSF, PCI-DSS v4.0, SOX, GDPR. Maintain the Network RCSA and publish monthly KRI dashboards to the Board Risk Committee. Our mission is to help our customers be successful by leading end-to-end their journey to MongoDB. In an era where AI agents handle routine migration mechanics - such as workload assessments, schema and query translations, and large-scale validation - our consultants focus on the high-judgment decisions that directly mitigate risk. Joining us now means helping draft the playbooks while they are actively being defined. We are seeking builders who prefer creating new frameworks over following legacy instructions. This role will be based remotely in Germany. Position expectations Delivery Plan and lead the technical delivery of data migration engagements end to end: source estate assessment, migration strategy and wave planning, schema and data-model transformation, pipeline build, validation, and production cutover with minimal downtime Design and operate change data capture (CDC) pipelines for zero and near-zero-downtime migrations - using Kafka and the connector ecosystem, Debezium and comparable log-based CDC tooling, and cloud-native replication services Bring genuine platform depth on the estates our customers are leaving: Cassandra data modeling and anti-patterns, Cosmos DB (Core and Mongo API) partitioning and RU economics, DocumentDB's compatibility surface - and use it to de-risk what the customer cannot see coming Work shoulder to shoulder with enterprise customers - architects, DBAs, platform teams and executives - from whiteboard to war room Own the full consulting lifecycle for your engagements, from planning and agenda-setting through post-engagement follow-up, surfacing risks and further opportunities back to Sales and Professional Services Pre-sales and growth Partner with Solutions Architects, Engagement Managers and account teams to scope and size migration opportunities, shape statements of work and estimation models, and give sales well-founded confidence in what is achievable and what it will take Cultivate your reputation as a migrations SME and trusted advisor, internally and in the market, and positively influence your own utilization through proactive customer engagement Identify services opportunities in our customers, new workloads or estates to be migrated or product improvements the customer could benefit from Building the practice Build and harden the AI tooling that makes migrations faster and safer: agents for automated estate assessment, schema and data-model conversion, query and code translation, and large-scale data validation - and fold what works into the standard delivery methodology Turn field experience into reusable assets: migration playbooks, reference architectures, estimation models, tooling improvements and enablement for the wider team Partner with Product and Engineering to bring field reality into MongoDB's product and migration-tooling roadmap Candidate profile Excellent analytical, diagnostic and problem-solving skills, and the composure to apply them during a production cutover Degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field, and a technology-first mindset that lets you build credibility with some of the smartest technologists in the world 5+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or consulting delivery roles centred on data platforms and data movement at production scale Hands-on experience with at least one of: Apache Cassandra, Azure Cosmos DB, Amazon DocumentDB, or another distributed NoSQL platform - Depending on the number of applications received, successive phases of Selection may include shortlisting of candidates based assessment of the information provided in the cover letter, CV; practical testing and interviews. At least the 3 best candidates will be invited to the final interview. Only candidates admitted to each successive selection phase will be contacted individually. During the selection process, please do not contact the members of the Selection Committee, but address your questions and comments to the Delegation’s Administration. Upon receipt, the Delegation will review the matter and, where appropriate, consult Headquarters before providing a response. Finance and investment leadership will be central to Nami's next chapter. Job purpose As a member of the executive leadership team, reporting to the CEO and Board, the Chief Financial Officer leads the group's financial, treasury and investment activities. The CFO owns capital strategy and allocation, financial planning and control, risk and governance, and investor relations — ensuring the company delivers its board-approved strategy and three-year plan while building the financial foundation for Nami's next phase of growth, including its holding-company structure and future capital-markets readiness. Key responsibilities 1. Financial strategy & planning •  Own the group's financial strategy, three-year plan, annual budgets and capital-allocation framework, aligning capital deployment with the board-approved strategy. •  Set working-capital strategy, capital-efficiency monitoring, and the performance measures and reporting that steer the business toward its targets. 2. Financial management, controlling & reporting •  Oversee accounting, cash flow, asset management, internal controls and transaction processing across the group and its project SPVs, safeguarding balance-sheet integrity. •  Deliver timely, accurate reporting to the CEO, Board, lenders and investors; drive cost discipline and a strong control environment; own key banking relationships. 3. Treasury, cash & funding •  Manage cash forecasting and liquidity for operating and investment needs; deploy surplus capital efficiently to optimise returns. •  Arrange and manage debt and equity financing at group and project level, including refinancing. 4. Risk, governance & compliance •  Build and maintain an enterprise risk-management framework covering operational, financial, legal and regulatory risk. •  Ensure full compliance with corporate-governance and regulatory requirements, in coordination with Legal, and uphold DFI / IFC performance-standard expectations. 5. Investment & M&A •  Lead investment evaluation end-to-end — sourcing, due diligence and return / risk assessment — and bring clear pre-investment recommendations to leadership and the Board. •  Lead deal structuring and negotiation; oversee post-merger financial integration and divestments. 6. Capital raising & investor relations •  Lead equity and debt raises from term negotiation through due diligence, documentation and close. •  Build and sustain relationships with institutional and development-finance investors and lenders; manage investor communications in line with legal and disclosure requirements. 7. Corporate structuring & capital-markets readiness •  Drive the group's holding-company structuring (including the Singapore holding entity) and the associated tax, governance and residency considerations. •  Prepare the finance function, reporting and controls for future capital-markets and IPO readiness. 8. Leadership & organisation •  Build, lead and develop a high-performing finance and investment team. •  Embed data-driven decision-making and AI-enabled financial analysis and forecasting, supported by finance systems and processes that scale with the group. Requirements Education •  University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or a related field. •  Professional qualification required or strongly preferred (ACCA / FCCA, CFA, CPA or equivalent). Related experience •  10+ years of progressive finance leadership, with proven experience as CFO / Group CFO or equivalent. •  Sector experience in renewable energy and/or infrastructure strongly preferred; private-equity or DFI-backed environments an advantage. •  Demonstrated track record in capital raising (equity and debt), deal structuring, due diligence, M&A and investor relations with institutional and development-finance investors. •  Strong exposure to financial controlling and reporting, business partnering, regulatory and compliance environments, and transformation, integration or growth initiatives. •  Experience supporting holding-company structuring and/or capital-markets / IPO readiness is a plus. Essential capabilities •  Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with excellent commercial acumen. •  High integrity and a strong governance mindset. •  Influential, board-level leadership and stakeholder-management skills. •  Ability to leverage AI tools to drive financial analysis, forecasting and investment decision-making. Language & tools •  Fluent in English and Vietnamese. •  Proficient in AI tools, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, ERP systems and financial modelling. This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia. Our values: Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration. Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems. Strive: We are driven and determined. Excellence: We seek to deliver the best. Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet. The Associate Director will establish an approval-to-cash view of capital spend, improve portfolio Latest Best Estimate (LBE) and cash forecasting, identify capex and operating cost risks, and provide clear financial challenge to Design & Construction, Operations, Procurement, Treasury and Country Finance. The role includes direct people management of a small team of finance analysts and influences cross-functional stakeholders. This role will be based in Singapore and will support projects and operations across Asia Pacific. Key responsibilities: 1. Capex Governance and Approval-to-Cash Reporting Own the monthly approval-to-cash reporting framework covering approved budget, commitments, invoices, cash paid, LBE, contingency usage and key delivery risks. Establish exception reporting and escalation for material cost overruns, cash slippage, contingency drawdown, approval gaps and late commitments. Portfolio LBE, Cash Forecasting and Investment Analytics Improve capex LBE accuracy and cash-flow visibility by integrating inputs from Development, Procurement and Country Finance. Support investment reviews by validating financial assumptions, capex phasing, contingency, return metrics, sensitivity analysis and key commercial risks. Prepare executive-level commentary on capex, cash and portfolio risks, with clear recommendations and accountable follow-ups. 3. Operating Cost Efficiency Partner with Operations and Country Finance to analyse power, repairs and maintenance, facilities management and maintenance capex trends. Identify cost efficiency opportunities using driver analysis across volume, rate, mix, utilization and timing. Develop benchmarking and unit-cost analysis across sites. Translate operating cost movements into senior management insight, separating controllable performance from market, usage and timing effects. 4. Team Leadership, Controls and Ways of Working Lead, coach and develop a small team of finance analysts supporting capex reporting, operating cost analysis and portfolio performance reviews. review_candidates.title: Africa Partnerships & Engagement Manager/Senior Manager
review_candidates.description: About CEPI CEPI is an innovative partnership between public, private, philanthropic and civil organisations. Its mission is to accelerate the development of vaccines and other biologic countermeasures against epidemic and pandemic threats so they can be accessible to all people in need. Central to CEPI’s pandemic-beating plan is the ‘100 Days Mission’ – its goal to develop safe, effective and accessible vaccines against new threats in just 100 days. CEPI’s work has delivered world firsts for vaccines against many of its priority pathogens including the first licensed Chikungunya vaccine, the first ever Lassa fever, Nipah and MERS vaccines to reach Phase II trials and the first Rift Valley fever vaccine candidate to be studied in Phase II in an endemic region. CEPI has also supported programmes to generate much-needed data to expand access to Ebola and Mpox vaccines. CEPI was among the first funders of COVID-19 vaccines, ultimately building one of the world’s largest portfolios, seven of which were licensed. The Coalition also conceptualised and co-founded COVAX, which delivered nearly two billion doses of COVID-19 vaccines to 146 countries, saving an estimated 2.7 million lives in lower-income regions. Earlier this year, CEPI launched its CEPI 3.0 Strategy (covering 2027-2031) which will systematically reduce the likelihood and impact of epidemics and pandemics by driving the 100 Days Mission towards an operational reality. CEPI is a not-for-profit association under Norwegian Law and has offices in Oslo (HQ), London, and Washington DC. In CEPI we strive for diverse thinking, and we want a diverse pool of candidates for all our vacancies. We work for an inclusive working environment where each employee can contribute and grow. Learn more at www.cepi.net About the role CEPI is looking for an Africa Partnerships and Engagement Manager/Senior Manager to support the delivery of its Africa regional strategy and engagement with partners on a 12-month full-time contract. The role will focus primarily on enabling internal alignment, driving cross-functional collaboration and ensuring effective implementation of regional priorities across the organisation. The role will be responsible for building relationships, developing and maintaining program workplans, tracking progress, supporting external engagements and managing correspondence to ensure alignment with organisational goals. The role requires a good understanding of the key regional health institutions, the African research preparedness ecosystem, priorities and partners (including research, clinical trials, regulatory and manufacturing). The position holder will report to the Head of Africa Strategy and Engagement and be part of the Africa team within the Public Partnerships Department (PPD). The Department leads on CEPI’s relationships with international and regional institutions with which CEPI engages and collaborates to support shared goals on the rapid development and equitable access to vaccines against emerging epidemic and pandemic pathogens including contributing to regional innovation and manufacturing eco-systems that can meet outbreak and broader health product research needs. PPD leads the development of regional strategies to support better alignment across CEPI’s investments and partnerships in Africa, Asia, Europe and Latin America, and alignment with regional priorities and initiatives. Responsibilities Support the implementation of CEPI’s Africa regional strategy, ensuring alignment across R&D, manufacturing, access and other workstreams Drive cross-functional collaboration across internal teams, ensuring coherence between regional priorities and organisational strategy Contribute to the development of strategic documents, presentations, and internal communications related to the Africa regional portfolio Support engagement with regional partners and stakeholders, including coordination of inputs and follow-through on agreed actions Support internal alignment by synthesising inputs, preparing briefings including updates for senior leadership, and facilitating strategy and engagement processes Develop, maintain and regularly update programme workplans, tracking progress against key milestones and identifying risks to delivery Manage programme-related communications and correspondence, ensuring consistency, timeliness and alignment with organisational priorities, as well as support the planning and delivery of key meetings, workshops and engagements Other duties as required Education, Experience and Competence Essential: Bachelor’s degree (Master’s desirable) in a discipline related to public or global health/policy and communications/finance/International Relations, or other relevant discipline. Preferable experience: 5 – 10 years in Global Health and Health Security preferred, with experience working in Africa or with African institutions Previous experience working with key regional and national partners in the African region or other LMICs desirable, as well as a good knowledge of the broader global health ecosystem Essential: Proficient in MS Office and comfortable with applying new IT tools across tasks. Coordination of strategic partnerships, project and portfolio management experience, including operationalisation of governance processes, and implementation of policies. Excellent track record of results in managing stakeholder relationships and coordinating large teams. Proficiency in project management tools and data analysis with excellent written and verbal communication skills, including scientific writing High level of sensitivity and diplomacy, with excellent networking, representational, communications and negotiation skills. Proactive and can-do attitude takes accountability for delivery. Strong written and verbal English language skills. Ability to speak French will be an added advantage. Ability to adapt and work within a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment. Travel and Location Requirements This position is based in London, UK. Applicant needs to possess a valid work permit (UK) for the duration of this role. CEPI would not be able to support relocation for this fixed term position. International travel to other CEPI offices and partners as assigned. What we can offer you The opportunity to work together with leading experts on solutions for global challenges Experience from the international effort on developing vaccines against emerging infectious diseases and accelerating vaccine development response to outbreaks A diverse and inclusive working environment How to apply For more information on how to apply, please visit: https://cepisites.secure.force.com/careers Should you have any issues submitting your application or have questions please contact jobs@cepi.net Background verification will be conducted to verify information provided in the CV and available documentation. review_candidates.title: Senior Business Development Executive - MENA
review_candidates.description: You've already recruited partners, closed deals, and learned what a bad commission structure costs. Now you'll do it with a bigger portfolio, tougher accounts, and more say in how the deals get built — and you'll be the person newer executives turn to when a partner conversation gets hard. Why This Matters Deriv processes more than $700B in monthly trading volume. A significant share of that comes through partners — Introducing Brokers, affiliates, fintech partners, and payment providers who bring traders to the platform across more than 150 countries. The Growth Partnerships function sits at the heart of that engine. When a high-value IB in MENA goes live, when an affiliate activates a corridor that's been stalled for months, when a renegotiation actually holds instead of falling apart — that's the kind of outcome a senior executive is expected to own. Real money, real regulations, real consequences. The portfolio you carry moves the region's numbers, not just your own. Why Deriv We're already running AI in production — not running pilots. 65%+ of customer enquiries resolved by AI, with genuine judgment about when to escalate Multi-agent systems handling partner onboarding, lifecycle management, and operational workflows across the GP function 400+ internal users on our workflow orchestration platform Campaign pipelines producing content in hours, not weeks These aren't tools you learn once and forget. You'll work in them daily, and you're expected to know them well enough to say when they're getting it wrong. What You’ll Do Partner acquisition and recruitment. Recruit and grow high-value IBs, affiliates, fintech partners, payment providers, and strategic alliances across your assigned MENA markets — including the harder-to-close accounts junior executives tend to hand off. Portfolio activation and performance. Own the full lifecycle for a larger, more complex portfolio, from onboarding through to revenue performance. Spot underperforming accounts before the numbers make it obvious, and build the plan to fix them. Commercial deal structuring. Negotiate commission structures, volume targets, and support agreements with more latitude on terms than an entry-level role carries. Know the unit economics well enough to defend a deal to your own leadership, not just to the partner. AI-enabled operational contribution. Work inside AI-enabled onboarding and lifecycle systems, and flag workflow gaps to product and engineering with enough specificity that they can actually act on it. Mentorship within the team. Help onboard and troubleshoot for newer Business Development Executives, sharing what you've learned about reading partners and structuring deals that hold up. Industry representation. Represent Deriv at conferences and partner events — including iFX Expo, Finance Magnates, Forex Expo Dubai, and regional growth events — where you're expected to open doors, not just attend. Who You Are You've spent a couple of years in business development, partnerships, or sales within online trading, FX/CFD, fintech, or a comparably performance-driven digital ecosystem, and you can point to deals you actually closed. You know how IB and affiliate ecosystems operate well enough to spot a bad deal structure before it costs anyone money. You don't just open conversations — you close them, and you can explain why a deal was structured the way it was without leaning on a script. You're the person a newer teammate asks when a partner conversation stalls, and you're comfortable being that resource without a formal management title. You use AI tools daily in your own workflow, and when something in the system doesn't fit how partners actually behave, you say so specifically instead of working around it quietly. Fluency in English and Arabic is required, given the role's focus on MENA. Additional languages — French, Spanish, or Portuguese — are an advantage if your remit extends further. You hold a relevant degree in business, economics, finance, or equivalent, and have close to five years of relevant experience. The Honest Reality This is demanding work. You'll be handed the accounts junior executives couldn't close, and some of them won't close for you either. You'll make commercial calls with incomplete information and live with how they play out — and you'll be expected to help train the person next to you while you're still building out your own portfolio. If you want a role where the hard accounts get handed to someone more senior, this isn't it. If you want to be the person those accounts get handed to, it might be.

review_candidates.description: Highlights: Location: Armenia Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+) About Fundraise Up We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver. A Truly Global Product We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe. We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals , admin tools , and several internal apps. The Team We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first. About In-Person Giving At Fundraise Up In-Person Giving brings the quality and connected data of Fundraise Up’s online donation experience into physical fundraising moments. The product begins with Tap to Donate and Giving Station: staff-led and self-service experiences that let nonprofits accept contactless donations at events, in public spaces, and through other offline workflows. Every transaction should connect to the same campaigns, donor records, reporting, CRM integrations, and operational controls used across Fundraise Up. The next product direction is Events & Commerce . It includes ticket sales, check-in, merchandise and food purchases, symbolic purchases, auctions, paddle raises, and additional donations before and during an event. These capabilities must work as one connected fundraising system rather than another isolated event tool. About The Role We are hiring a Product Manager to own Events & Commerce within the broader In-Person Giving product line. This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn a large category into a focused product direction grounded in customer workflows, live usage, and commercial evidence. You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader In-Person Giving area so that event commerce builds on the same payment, campaign, donor-data, reporting, mobile, and operational foundations as Tap to Donate and Giving Station. You will also partner with the Peer-to-Peer team where ticketing and event capabilities should be shared rather than rebuilt separately. This is not an event-planning, sales, or internal project-coordination role. What You’ll Own Define the product direction Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear Events & Commerce product thesis and sequenced roadmap. Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to replace every event platform at once. Decide which capabilities belong in the shared In-Person Giving foundation and which require an Events-specific model. Make explicit decisions about what Fundraise Up should build, integrate, partner on, or deliberately exclude. Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions visible. Lead discovery and product definition Work directly with nonprofit fundraising teams, event operators, finance teams, volunteers, attendees, donors, design partners, and internal GTM teams. Map the complete workflow before, during, and after an event—including purchase, donation, check-in, fulfillment, reconciliation, reporting, and follow-up. Validate decisions through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, and live product usage. Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and expectations created by incumbent event platforms. Shape problems such as ticket sales, QR-based check-in, guest management, commerce catalogues, FMV and receipts, on-site purchases, auctions, paddle raises, refunds, attribution, reporting, and integrations. These are examples—not a pre-committed feature checklist. Shape and deliver the product Own the product from problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration. Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, state transitions, and decision records. Make day-to-day scope and trade-off decisions with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, QA, and GTM partners. Design for real event conditions: staff and volunteer operators, self-service flows, mobile devices, optional hardware, unreliable connectivity, high-volume moments, and operational recovery. Ensure that event capabilities reuse Fundraise Up’s existing payments, campaign, donor, reporting, CRM, and identity infrastructure wherever possible. Keep delivery predictable by surfacing dependencies, risks, and unresolved decisions early. Launch, learn, and drive outcomes Launch through EAPs with clear entry criteria, target workflows, success measures, readiness requirements, and out-of-scope areas. Understand whether organizations can configure and run the target event workflows without heavy manual work or disconnected tools. Measure whether attendees can purchase, check in, donate, and receive the right confirmation or receipt through a clear experience. Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations on positioning, commitments, enablement, and launch readiness. Connect product evidence to activation, adoption, event completion, GPV, expansion, pipeline, retention, and operational cost. Turn evidence into explicit recommendations: iterate, expand, change direction, partner, or stop. Work AI-native Use AI for research synthesis, workflow analysis, prototyping, specification quality, data exploration, and operational automation. Build testable artifacts quickly without outsourcing product judgment. Requirements 4–7 years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in a software product company. End-to-end ownership of a customer-facing product area with Engineering and Design. Strong judgment in reducing a large problem space to a focused release and explaining the trade-offs. Experience turning customer evidence and product data into decisions. Clear written communication across requirements, edge cases, metrics, and decision records. Ability to work with transactional, multi-actor workflows involving permissions, states, money, and data relationships. High ownership and independence, with fluent written and spoken English. Strong plus Experience with ticketing, event technology, commerce, POS, payments, marketplaces, registration, auctions, or other transaction-heavy products. Experience with mobile applications, contactless payments, physical devices, or hardware-enabled workflows. Experience with B2B SaaS, fundraising, nonprofits, or other operationally complex customer environments. Experience launching a new product area through beta or EAP. Knowledge of CRM integrations, financial reconciliation, reporting, transaction attribution, analytics, or SQL. Practical use of AI for research, prototyping, analysis, or product operations. This Role May Not Be a Fit If You are looking for an event-planning or internal project-management role rather than software product ownership. You prefer to receive a fully defined roadmap and requirements instead of helping determine what should be built. You want to work only on strategy and avoid specifications, QA, delivery details, or post-launch iteration. You treat every customer request as a roadmap commitment. You need stable scope and certainty before moving forward. You measure progress mainly by features shipped rather than customer and business outcomes. Why work with us Build a new product direction from research through live customer use. Work in a large, proven fundraising category with clear customer demand and meaningful commercial potential. Shape ticketing and event commerce as part of a broader fundraising platform rather than an isolated event tool. Work with real nonprofit customers, rich product evidence, and experienced cross-functional partners. Join a small team where product managers have meaningful ownership and direct access to Product leadership. Help define an AI-native approach to product management in practice. Build technology that helps nonprofits engage more supporters and raise more money for their missions. Compensation The compensation range for this role is $4,600 - $5,000 gross. Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location. Benefits 31 days off 100% paid telemedicine plan Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace. English learning courses Relevant professional education Gym or swimming pool Co-working Remote working Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. review_candidates.description: [무신사 테크 ​소개] 팀 ​무신사 ​테크 조직은 ​혁신의 원동력이자 변화를 선도하는 ​핵심 ​기술 조직입니다. ​고객과 입점 브랜드가 ​각자의 고유한 ​개성을 ​자유롭게 표현할 ​수 ​있도록, ​데이터와 기술을 기반으로 ​한 ​개인화된 경험을 제공합니다. ​무신사 ​테크는 ​새로운 도전을 두려워하지 ​않으며, 항상 ​새로운 ​영역에서의 성공을 ​꿈꿉니다. 무신사는 ​한국을 ​넘어 글로벌 시장에서도 ​경쟁력 있는 ​서비스를 선보이고자 OCMP(One Core Multi Platform) 를 구축하고 있습니다. 이를 통해 전체 비즈니스의 폭발적 성장을 지원하며 무신사 테크는 끊임없는 도전과 혁신으로 고객에게 더 나은 가치를 제공하고자 합니다. 무신사 테크 블로그 29CM 테크 블로그 테크 유튜브 채널 무신사 링크드인 MUSINSA TECH [팀 소개] "One Flow, Infinite Retail" Core-E SC&F 조직은 코드로 현실의 경계를 허뭅니다. 우리는 온라인의 데이터가 물류 센터의 로봇을 움직이고, 오프라인 매장의 고객 접점으로 이어지는 단 하나의 끊김 없는 흐름(One Flow)을 설계 합니다. 우리가 설계한 코드와 시스템이 실제 주문 흐름과 물류, 매장 운영에 그대로 반영될 때 무신사의 리테일은 하나의 완성된 플랫폼이 됩니다. 단순한 커머스를 넘어 온·오프라인과 글로벌을 아우르는 Infinite Retail 의 기술적 근간을 만드는 Core-E SC&F 조직은 아래 4개의 영역을 다루는 전문 팀이 유기적으로 협력하며 거대한 통합 리테일 플랫폼(Integrated Retail Platform)을 구축하고 있습니다. • OMS(Order Management System): 전 채널의 주문과 재고 데이터를 실시간으로 동기화하고 최적의 출고지를 결정하는 주문 오케스트레이션의 중심입니다. 복잡한 비즈니스 규칙과 수많은 예외 상황 속에서도 주문 흐름이 멈추지 않도록 설계하고, 확장 가능한 구조로 무신사의 성장을 뒷받침합니다. • WMS(Warehouse Management System): AGV, 소터 등 최첨단 자동화 설비와 소프트웨어를 결합해 풀필먼트의 물리적 한계를 기술로 확장합니다. 초당 수천 건의 입·출고를 실시간으로 처리하는 고가용성·고신뢰성 물류 시스템을 구축하며, 현장의 복잡성을 코드로 단순화합니다. • O4O(Online for Offline): 무신사 스탠다드와 편집숍 등 오프라인 공간의 모든 접점을 디지털화합니다. 매장의 재고와 운영 데이터를 실시간으로 클라우드에 연동하고, 온라인과 오프라인의 경계를 허무는 심리스한 고객 경험을 만들어 갑니다. • SCM(Supply Chain Management): 수억 건의 데이터를 기반으로 수요를 예측하고 공급망 전반을 최적화하는 의사결정 플랫폼을 구축합니다. 데이터와 알고리즘을 통해 비즈니스 효율을 극대화하고, 무신사의 다음 성장을 설계합니다. [이런 문제를 같이 해결하고 싶어요] • 리테일의 멀티버스(Multiverse) 통합: 온라인(무신사, 29CM)과 오프라인 매장, 글로벌 시장까지 각기 다른 비즈니스 요구사항을 관통하는 하나의 코어 시스템을 설계합니다. • 초당 수만 건의 데이터 정면승부: 대규모 할인 행사나 오프라인 매장 오픈 시 발생하는 폭발적인 트래픽 속에서도 데이터 무결성을 보장하는 고가용성 시스템을 만듭니다. • 리테일계의 내비게이션, 오케스트레이션: 온·오프라인의 경계 없이 가장 효율적인 출고지와 배송 경로를 실시간으로 판단하여 최적의 리테일 흐름(Flow)을 제어하는 지능형 엔진을 구축합니다. • SF 영화를 현실로, 물류 자동화: 로봇 및 자동화 설비(WES/WCS)와 연동하여 사람의 개입을 최소화하고 운영 효율을 극대화하는 알고리즘을 구현합니다. [담당 업무] 무신사 풀필먼트의 핵심인 OMS·WMS를 고도화하고, 신규 아키텍처를 설계합니다. 무신사 오프라인 매장(무신사 스탠다드·편집숍) 운영을 위한 통합 관리 솔루션과 O4O 백엔드 서비스를 개발합니다. 대용량 주문·재고 처리를 위한 MSA 기반 시스템을 구축하고, 대규모 트래픽에 안정적으로 대응할 수 있는 아키텍처를 설계합니다. 수요 예측 및 물류 최적화를 위한 SCM 데이터 파이프라인과 관련 플랫폼을 개발합니다 [기술 스택] • Language: Java, Kotlin • Framework: Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, JPA/Hibernate • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform • Database: MySQL, Redis, PostgreSQL • Message Broker: Kafka, RabbitMQ • Monitoring: Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana [자격 요건] 8년 이상의 백엔드 개발 경험을 보유하고, 복잡한 비즈니스 로직을 코드와 아키텍처로 구조화할 수 있는 분 Java/Kotlin 및 Spring 기반의 탄탄한 개발 역량을 보유하고, 대규모 트래픽 환경을 경험해 보신 분 복잡한 도메인에 대한 높은 이해를 바탕으로 객체지향적인 설계와 클린 코드를 지향하시는 분 비즈니스 목표를 달성하기 위해 기술적 의사결정을 주도하고 리딩해 본 경험이 있으신 분 CI/CD 기반의 배포 자동화 및 안정적인 서비스 운영 프로세스에 대한 경험과 이해를 갖추신 분 [우대 사항] 커머스·리테일·운영 시스템 등 복잡한 비즈니스 흐름을 다루는 백엔드 개발 경험이 있으신 분 물류·SCM·ERP·정산·재고 등 운영 도메인 중 하나 이상에 대한 이해 또는 시스템 구축 경험이 있으신 분 복잡한 도메인 환경에서 시스템을 안정적으로 설계하고 운영해 본 경험이 있으신 분 레거시 시스템을 점진적으로 개선하거나 MSA 전환을 통해 시스템 구조를 고도화해 본 경험이 있으신 분 기술적 문제와 의사결정 과정을 문서화하고 공유하는 문화에 익숙하신 분 자동화 설비(IoT·WES/WCS)와의 시스템 연동 경험이 있으신 분 [지원 서류] 이력서(필수) / 포트폴리오(선택) (참고) 이력서/포트폴리오 작성 팁 이력서/포트폴리오에는 왜 해당 문제를 해결해야 했는지, 어떤 전략을 세웠는지, 어떤 성과가 있었는지 등에 대한 문제 정의, 문제 해결, 성과에 대한 전반적인 내용을 담아주세요. 프로젝트의 성공과 실패를 떠나, 1차 면접에서 인터뷰어와 심도있는 이야기를 나눌 수 있도록 프로젝트의 이해도가 높은 이력서로 구성해주세요. (프로젝트별 기여도 표시) [근무 조건] 정규직 [전형 절차] 접수 기간 : 상시지원 전형 절차 : 서류 검토 - 1차 인터뷰(2회) - 2차 인터뷰(컬쳐핏) - 최종합격 1차 인터뷰는 Live Coding과 Architecture Design으로 진행됩니다. 결과에 따라 PBO 엔지니어링실 내 적합한 팀으로 제안될 수 있습니다. [기타사항] 본 포지션은 수시 진행으로 우수 인재 채용 시 마감될 수 있습니다. 적합한 지원자에게 채용 담당자가 개별 연락 예정이며, 내부 규정에 따라 각 전형 단계별 개별 피드백은 제공하지 않습니다. 최종 합격자는 3개월간의 수습기간이 적용되며, 해당 기간 중 급여는 100% 지급됩니다. 입사 지원 서류에 허위사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

new_matches.title: Senior Consulting Engineer
new_matches.description: The team MongoDB's Application Modernization Platform (AMP) organization is the front door of our modernization business. In our Data Migration practice we move production data - safely, repeatably, at enterprise scale - from relational estates (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and from NoSQL platforms (Apache Cassandra, Azure Cosmos DB, Amazon DocumentDB) onto MongoDB. We do this both as standalone migration programmes and as the data workstream inside larger application-modernization engagements, using MongoDB's own tooling - Relational Migrator, Cluster-to-Cluster Sync, Atlas Stream Processing - alongside the open-source and cloud-native pipeline ecosystem. Our mission is to help our customers be successful by leading end-to-end their journey to MongoDB. In an era where AI agents handle routine migration mechanics - such as workload assessments, schema and query translations, and large-scale validation - our consultants focus on the high-judgment decisions that directly mitigate risk. Joining us now means helping draft the playbooks while they are actively being defined. We are seeking builders who prefer creating new frameworks over following legacy instructions. This role will be based remotely in Germany. Position expectations Delivery Plan and lead the technical delivery of data migration engagements end to end: source estate assessment, migration strategy and wave planning, schema and data-model transformation, pipeline build, validation, and production cutover with minimal downtime Design and operate change data capture (CDC) pipelines for zero and near-zero-downtime migrations - using Kafka and the connector ecosystem, Debezium and comparable log-based CDC tooling, and cloud-native replication services Bring genuine platform depth on the estates our customers are leaving: Cassandra data modeling and anti-patterns, Cosmos DB (Core and Mongo API) partitioning and RU economics, DocumentDB's compatibility surface - and use it to de-risk what the customer cannot see coming Work shoulder to shoulder with enterprise customers - architects, DBAs, platform teams and executives - from whiteboard to war room Own the full consulting lifecycle for your engagements, from planning and agenda-setting through post-engagement follow-up, surfacing risks and further opportunities back to Sales and Professional Services Pre-sales and growth Partner with Solutions Architects, Engagement Managers and account teams to scope and size migration opportunities, shape statements of work and estimation models, and give sales well-founded confidence in what is achievable and what it will take Cultivate your reputation as a migrations SME and trusted advisor, internally and in the market, and positively influence your own utilization through proactive customer engagement Identify services opportunities in our customers, new workloads or estates to be migrated or product improvements the customer could benefit from Building the practice Build and harden the AI tooling that makes migrations faster and safer: agents for automated estate assessment, schema and data-model conversion, query and code translation, and large-scale data validation - and fold what works into the standard delivery methodology Turn field experience into reusable assets: migration playbooks, reference architectures, estimation models, tooling improvements and enablement for the wider team Partner with Product and Engineering to bring field reality into MongoDB's product and migration-tooling roadmap Candidate profile Excellent analytical, diagnostic and problem-solving skills, and the composure to apply them during a production cutover Degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field, and a technology-first mindset that lets you build credibility with some of the smartest technologists in the world 5+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or consulting delivery roles centred on data platforms and data movement at production scale Hands-on experience with at least one of: Apache Cassandra, Azure Cosmos DB, Amazon DocumentDB, or another distributed NoSQL platform - deep enough to reason about data models, consistency, partitioning and failure modes, not just operate one Real-world CDC and streaming-pipeline experience: Kafka or Confluent Platform, connectors, Debezium or equivalent, schema evolution, exactly-once versus at-least-once trade-offs, backfill-plus-tail patterns Solid grounding in relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL or MySQL) and in getting data out of them without breaking the business Competence in at least one programming language (Java, Python, Node.js, C#, Go or similar) - enough to build pipeline glue, validation harnesses and tooling, not only to configure products Working fluency with AI in real engineering workflows Excellent customer interaction and presentation skills: you can explain a partitioning strategy to a DBA at 10:00 and a migration risk profile to a Senior Leadership at 11:00, and both leave more confident than they arrived An entrepreneurial bias. You see the gaps and what is missing. You are comfortable operating where the process does not exist yet, and you would rather ship a rough first version and iterate than wait for the shape to be agreed MongoDB expertise is not a requirement. We will teach you MongoDB - that is the part we are world-class at. What we cannot teach is the scar tissue from the platforms and pipelines above. Bring that. Nice to have Experience building with LLMs beyond personal productivity: you use LLMs and coding agents as part of how you build and deliver today Migration or replication tooling experience: Spark or Flink-based pipelines, dual-write patterns, cloud DMS-class services, data-validation frameworks One or more cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) at architecture depth Experience on the vendor or consulting side of competitive platform displacements Practical experience with MongoDB Fluency in a second European language relevant to this market Practicalities Travel up to approximately 30% in normal circumstances, primarily within EMEA. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. The must-haves: BSc/MSc in Software Development, Computer Science, or Telecommunications / Electronics Engineering - interns and fresh graduates welcome. Test-automation fundamentals with Java and/or Python. English mandatory in reading and writing; good spoken English for global teamwork. Ability to read technical specifications; analytical, methodical troubleshooting mindset. Able to work both independently and within an international team. Additional advantage (developed through on-the-job training): Test automation with JCAT. 4G / 5G experience, multi-RAT. Wireshark, Xena, Spirent; log analysis. Test equipment & UE simulators (TM500 / VIAVI / Anritsu). DevOps (Jenkins, containers, cloud labs). Benefits: Salary range (From Junior to Senior): 30M - 65M (Negotiable). Full statutory insurance (social, health & unemployment) paid by the employer on top of gross salary, per Vietnamese law. 13th-month salary. Hybrid working: 2–3 work-from-home days per week or flexible hours, per our client's global policy. Paid annual leave above the statutory 12 days: 15 days for new joiners, rising to 18 days after one year of employment. Private medical insurance (individual coverage; family option available). Meal allowance. Home internet connection allowance. Well-being benefit: sports/gym subscription. Company laptop and equipment provided, plus access to learning and training platforms. English training (optional). Phone allowance (management and senior roles). Long-term & short-term incentives and retention awards (for eligible grades). Working loation at Tay Ho, HN.

Its mission is to accelerate the development of vaccines and other biologic countermeasures against epidemic and pandemic threats so they can be accessible to all people in need. Central to CEPI’s pandemic-beating plan is the ‘100 Days Mission’ – its goal to develop safe, effective and accessible vaccines against new threats in just 100 days. CEPI’s work has delivered world firsts for vaccines against many of its priority pathogens including the first licensed Chikungunya vaccine, the first ever Lassa fever, Nipah and MERS vaccines to reach Phase II trials and the first Rift Valley fever vaccine candidate to be studied in Phase II in an endemic region. CEPI has also supported programmes to generate much-needed data to expand access to Ebola and Mpox vaccines. CEPI was among the first funders of COVID-19 vaccines, ultimately building one of the world’s largest portfolios, seven of which were licensed. The Coalition also conceptualised and co-founded COVAX, which delivered nearly two billion doses of COVID-19 vaccines to 146 countries, saving an estimated 2.7 million lives in lower-income regions. Earlier this year, CEPI launched its CEPI 3.0 Strategy (covering 2027-2031) which will systematically reduce the likelihood and impact of epidemics and pandemics by driving the 100 Days Mission towards an operational reality. CEPI is a not-for-profit association under Norwegian Law and has offices in Oslo (HQ), London, and Washington DC. In CEPI we strive for diverse thinking, and we want a diverse pool of candidates for all our vacancies. We work for an inclusive working environment where each employee can contribute and grow. Learn more at www.cepi.net About the role CEPI is looking for an Africa Partnerships and Engagement Manager/Senior Manager to support the delivery of its Africa regional strategy and engagement with partners on a 12-month full-time contract. The role will focus primarily on enabling internal alignment, driving cross-functional collaboration and ensuring effective implementation of regional priorities across the organisation. The role will be responsible for building relationships, developing and maintaining program workplans, tracking progress, supporting external engagements and managing correspondence to ensure alignment with organisational goals. The role requires a good understanding of the key regional health institutions, the African research preparedness ecosystem, priorities and partners (including research, clinical trials, regulatory and manufacturing). The position holder will report to the Head of Africa Strategy and Engagement and be part of the Africa team within the Public Partnerships Department (PPD). The Department leads on CEPI’s relationships with international and regional institutions with which CEPI engages and collaborates to support shared goals on the rapid development and equitable access to vaccines against emerging epidemic and pandemic pathogens including contributing to regional innovation and manufacturing eco-systems that can meet outbreak and broader health product research needs. PPD leads the development of regional strategies to support better alignment across CEPI’s investments and partnerships in Africa, Asia, Europe and Latin America, and alignment with regional priorities and initiatives. Responsibilities Support the implementation of CEPI’s Africa regional strategy, ensuring alignment across R&D, manufacturing, access and other workstreams Drive cross-functional collaboration across internal teams, ensuring coherence between regional priorities and organisational strategy Contribute to the development of strategic documents, presentations, and internal communications related to the Africa regional portfolio Support engagement with regional partners and stakeholders, including coordination of inputs and follow-through on agreed actions Support internal alignment by synthesising inputs, preparing briefings including updates for senior leadership, and facilitating strategy and engagement processes Develop, maintain and regularly update programme workplans, tracking progress against key milestones and identifying risks to delivery Manage programme-related communications and correspondence, ensuring consistency, timeliness and alignment with organisational priorities, as well as support the planning and delivery of key meetings, workshops and engagements Other duties as required Education, Experience and Competence Essential: Bachelor’s degree (Master’s desirable) in a discipline related to public or global health/policy and communications/finance/International Relations, or other relevant discipline. Preferable experience: 5 – 10 years in Global Health and Health Security preferred, with experience working in Africa or with African institutions Previous experience working with key regional and national partners in the African region or other LMICs desirable, as well as a good knowledge of the broader global health ecosystem Essential: Proficient in MS Office and comfortable with applying new IT tools across tasks. Coordination of strategic partnerships, project and portfolio management experience, including operationalisation of governance processes, and implementation of policies. Excellent track record of results in managing stakeholder relationships and coordinating large teams. Proficiency in project management tools and data analysis with excellent written and verbal communication skills, including scientific writing High level of sensitivity and diplomacy, with excellent networking, representational, communications and negotiation skills. Proactive and can-do attitude takes accountability for delivery. Strong written and verbal English language skills. Ability to speak French will be an added advantage. Ability to adapt and work within a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment. Travel and Location Requirements This position is based in London, UK. Applicant needs to possess a valid work permit (UK) for the duration of this role. CEPI would not be able to support relocation for this fixed term position. International travel to other CEPI offices and partners as assigned. What we can offer you The opportunity to work together with leading experts on solutions for global challenges Experience from the international effort on developing vaccines against emerging infectious diseases and accelerating vaccine development response to outbreaks A diverse and inclusive working environment How to apply For more information on how to apply, please visit: https://cepisites.secure.force.com/careers Should you have any issues submitting your application or have questions please contact jobs@cepi.net Background verification will be conducted to verify information provided in the CV and available documentation. Deadline for receiving applications is 24th September 2026 at 23:59 CET

Recruit and grow high-value IBs, affiliates, fintech partners, payment providers, and strategic alliances across your assigned MENA markets — including the harder-to-close accounts junior executives tend to hand off. Portfolio activation and performance. Own the full lifecycle for a larger, more complex portfolio, from onboarding through to revenue performance. Spot underperforming accounts before the numbers make it obvious, and build the plan to fix them. Commercial deal structuring. Negotiate commission structures, volume targets, and support agreements with more latitude on terms than an entry-level role carries. Know the unit economics well enough to defend a deal to your own leadership, not just to the partner. AI-enabled operational contribution. Work inside AI-enabled onboarding and lifecycle systems, and flag workflow gaps to product and engineering with enough specificity that they can actually act on it. Mentorship within the team. Help onboard and troubleshoot for newer Business Development Executives, sharing what you've learned about reading partners and structuring deals that hold up. Industry representation. Who You Are You've spent a couple of years in business development, partnerships, or sales within online trading, FX/CFD, fintech, or a comparably performance-driven digital ecosystem, and you can point to deals you actually closed. You know how IB and affiliate ecosystems operate well enough to spot a bad deal structure before it costs anyone money. You don't just open conversations — you close them, and you can explain why a deal was structured the way it was without leaning on a script. You're the person a newer teammate asks when a partner conversation stalls, and you're comfortable being that resource without a formal management title. You use AI tools daily in your own workflow, and when something in the system doesn't fit how partners actually behave, you say so specifically instead of working around it quietly. If you want a role where the hard accounts get handed to someone more senior, this isn't it. If you want to be the person those accounts get handed to, it might be.

new_matches.description: [무신사 테크 ​소개] 팀 ​무신사 ​테크 조직은 ​혁신의 원동력이자 변화를 선도하는 ​핵심 ​기술 조직입니다. ​고객과 입점 브랜드가 ​각자의 고유한 ​개성을 ​자유롭게 표현할 ​수 ​있도록, ​데이터와 기술을 기반으로 ​한 ​개인화된 경험을 제공합니다. ​무신사 ​테크는 ​새로운 도전을 두려워하지 ​않으며, 항상 ​새로운 ​영역에서의 성공을 ​꿈꿉니다. 무신사는 ​한국을 ​넘어 글로벌 시장에서도 ​경쟁력 있는 ​서비스를 선보이고자 OCMP(One Core Multi Platform) 를 구축하고 있습니다. 이를 통해 전체 비즈니스의 폭발적 성장을 지원하며 무신사 테크는 끊임없는 도전과 혁신으로 고객에게 더 나은 가치를 제공하고자 합니다. 무신사 테크 블로그 29CM 테크 블로그 테크 유튜브 채널 무신사 링크드인 MUSINSA TECH [팀 소개] "One Flow, Infinite Retail" Core-E SC&F 조직은 코드로 현실의 경계를 허뭅니다. 우리는 온라인의 데이터가 물류 센터의 로봇을 움직이고, 오프라인 매장의 고객 접점으로 이어지는 단 하나의 끊김 없는 흐름(One Flow)을 설계 합니다. 우리가 설계한 코드와 시스템이 실제 주문 흐름과 물류, 매장 운영에 그대로 반영될 때 무신사의 리테일은 하나의 완성된 플랫폼이 됩니다. 단순한 커머스를 넘어 온·오프라인과 글로벌을 아우르는 Infinite Retail 의 기술적 근간을 만드는 Core-E SC&F 조직은 아래 4개의 영역을 다루는 전문 팀이 유기적으로 협력하며 거대한 통합 리테일 플랫폼(Integrated Retail Platform)을 구축하고 있습니다. • OMS(Order Management System): 전 채널의 주문과 재고 데이터를 실시간으로 동기화하고 최적의 출고지를 결정하는 주문 오케스트레이션의 중심입니다. 복잡한 비즈니스 규칙과 수많은 예외 상황 속에서도 주문 흐름이 멈추지 않도록 설계하고, 확장 가능한 구조로 무신사의 성장을 뒷받침합니다. • WMS(Warehouse Management System): AGV, 소터 등 최첨단 자동화 설비와 소프트웨어를 결합해 풀필먼트의 물리적 한계를 기술로 확장합니다. 초당 수천 건의 입·출고를 실시간으로 처리하는 고가용성·고신뢰성 물류 시스템을 구축하며, 현장의 복잡성을 코드로 단순화합니다. • O4O(Online for Offline): 무신사 스탠다드와 편집숍 등 오프라인 공간의 모든 접점을 디지털화합니다. 매장의 재고와 운영 데이터를 실시간으로 클라우드에 연동하고, 온라인과 오프라인의 경계를 허무는 심리스한 고객 경험을 만들어 갑니다. • SCM(Supply Chain Management): 수억 건의 데이터를 기반으로 수요를 예측하고 공급망 전반을 최적화하는 의사결정 플랫폼을 구축합니다. 데이터와 알고리즘을 통해 비즈니스 효율을 극대화하고, 무신사의 다음 성장을 설계합니다. [이런 문제를 같이 해결하고 싶어요] • 리테일의 멀티버스(Multiverse) 통합: 온라인(무신사, 29CM)과 오프라인 매장, 글로벌 시장까지 각기 다른 비즈니스 요구사항을 관통하는 하나의 코어 시스템을 설계합니다. • 초당 수만 건의 데이터 정면승부: 대규모 할인 행사나 오프라인 매장 오픈 시 발생하는 폭발적인 트래픽 속에서도 데이터 무결성을 보장하는 고가용성 시스템을 만듭니다. • 리테일계의 내비게이션, 오케스트레이션: 온·오프라인의 경계 없이 가장 효율적인 출고지와 배송 경로를 실시간으로 판단하여 최적의 리테일 흐름(Flow)을 제어하는 지능형 엔진을 구축합니다. • SF 영화를 현실로, 물류 자동화: 로봇 및 자동화 설비(WES/WCS)와 연동하여 사람의 개입을 최소화하고 운영 효율을 극대화하는 알고리즘을 구현합니다. [담당 업무] 무신사 풀필먼트의 핵심인 OMS·WMS를 고도화하고, 신규 아키텍처를 설계합니다. 무신사 오프라인 매장(무신사 스탠다드·편집숍) 운영을 위한 통합 관리 솔루션과 O4O 백엔드 서비스를 개발합니다. 대용량 주문·재고 처리를 위한 MSA 기반 시스템을 구축하고, 대규모 트래픽에 안정적으로 대응할 수 있는 아키텍처를 설계합니다. 수요 예측 및 물류 최적화를 위한 SCM 데이터 파이프라인과 관련 플랫폼을 개발합니다 [기술 스택] • Language: Java, Kotlin • Framework: Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, JPA/Hibernate • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform • Database: MySQL, Redis, PostgreSQL • Message Broker: Kafka, RabbitMQ • Monitoring: Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana [자격 요건] 8년 이상의 백엔드 개발 경험을 보유하고, 복잡한 비즈니스 로직을 코드와 아키텍처로 구조화할 수 있는 분 Java/Kotlin 및 Spring 기반의 탄탄한 개발 역량을 보유하고, 대규모 트래픽 환경을 경험해 보신 분 복잡한 도메인에 대한 높은 이해를 바탕으로 객체지향적인 설계와 클린 코드를 지향하시는 분 비즈니스 목표를 달성하기 위해 기술적 의사결정을 주도하고 리딩해 본 경험이 있으신 분 CI/CD 기반의 배포 자동화 및 안정적인 서비스 운영 프로세스에 대한 경험과 이해를 갖추신 분 [우대 사항] 커머스·리테일·운영 시스템 등 복잡한 비즈니스 흐름을 다루는 백엔드 개발 경험이 있으신 분 물류·SCM·ERP·정산·재고 등 운영 도메인 중 하나 이상에 대한 이해 또는 시스템 구축 경험이 있으신 분 복잡한 도메인 환경에서 시스템을 안정적으로 설계하고 운영해 본 경험이 있으신 분 레거시 시스템을 점진적으로 개선하거나 MSA 전환을 통해 시스템 구조를 고도화해 본 경험이 있으신 분 기술적 문제와 의사결정 과정을 문서화하고 공유하는 문화에 익숙하신 분 자동화 설비(IoT·WES/WCS)와의 시스템 연동 경험이 있으신 분 [지원 서류] 이력서(필수) / 포트폴리오(선택) (참고) 이력서/포트폴리오 작성 팁 이력서/포트폴리오에는 왜 해당 문제를 해결해야 했는지, 어떤 전략을 세웠는지, 어떤 성과가 있었는지 등에 대한 문제 정의, 문제 해결, 성과에 대한 전반적인 내용을 담아주세요. 프로젝트의 성공과 실패를 떠나, 1차 면접에서 인터뷰어와 심도있는 이야기를 나눌 수 있도록 프로젝트의 이해도가 높은 이력서로 구성해주세요. (프로젝트별 기여도 표시) [근무 조건] 정규직 [전형 절차] 접수 기간 : 상시지원 전형 절차 : 서류 검토 - 1차 인터뷰(2회) - 2차 인터뷰(컬쳐핏) - 최종합격 1차 인터뷰는 Live Coding과 Architecture Design으로 진행됩니다. 결과에 따라 PBO 엔지니어링실 내 적합한 팀으로 제안될 수 있습니다. [기타사항] 본 포지션은 수시 진행으로 우수 인재 채용 시 마감될 수 있습니다. 적합한 지원자에게 채용 담당자가 개별 연락 예정이며, 내부 규정에 따라 각 전형 단계별 개별 피드백은 제공하지 않습니다. 최종 합격자는 3개월간의 수습기간이 적용되며, 해당 기간 중 급여는 100% 지급됩니다. 입사 지원 서류에 허위사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.
